results.name: Kettlebell Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell with both hands using a neutral grip in front of your hips, keeping your arms extended.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and curl the kettlebell toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your biceps without moving your upper arms.
Lower the kettlebell with control until your arms are extended, then repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms still as your elbows bend.
Avoid swinging the kettlebell or using momentum.
Lower the kettlebell slowly until your arms are extended.
Exhale as you curl and inhale as you lower.
results.description: Kettlebell Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Goblet Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell by the sides of the handle with both hands using a neutral grip in front of you.
Keep your elbows close to your body and curl the kettlebell upward toward your chest.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your biceps while keeping your upper arms still.
Lower the kettlebell with control until your arms are extended, then repeat.
tips: Keep your upper arms still as you bend your elbows.
Bring the kettlebell toward your upper chest without lifting your shoulders.
Lower the kettlebell slowly without swinging it.
Exhale as you curl and inhale as you lower.
results.description: Kettlebell Goblet Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Preacher Curl
instructions: Stand behind an incline bench and rest your right upper arm firmly against the bench. Hold a kettlebell with an underhand grip and let your arm extend downward.
Keep your upper arm supported and curl the kettlebell upward toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your biceps.
Lower the kettlebell with control until your arm is extended, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your elbow in the same position throughout the curl.
Curl the kettlebell without lifting your shoulder.
Keep your torso still and avoid using momentum.
Exhale as you curl and inhale as you lower.
results.description: Kettlebell Preacher Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Kettlebell Single Arm Curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart and hold a kettlebell in one hand by your side using an underhand grip.
Keep your elbow close to your body and curl the kettlebell toward your shoulder.
Pause briefly at the top and squeeze your biceps while keeping your upper arm still.
Lower the kettlebell with control until your arm is extended, then repeat before switching sides.
tips: Keep your elbow close to your torso.
Keep your wrist straight and aligned with your forearm.
Avoid swinging the kettlebell or using momentum.
Exhale as you curl and inhale as you lower.
results.description: Kettlebell Single Arm Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a kettlebell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.

results.name: Landmine Bicep Curl
instructions: Stand facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar with both hands, palms up, arms extended.
Keep your elbows close to your sides.
Curl the bar up toward your chest by bending your elbows.
Lower it with control to full extension and repeat.
tips: Don't lean back to lift the bar.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
results.description: Landmine Bicep Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Brachialis.

results.name: Landmine Concentration Curl
instructions: Kneel or sit beside the landmine and hold the end of the bar in one hand, palm up.
Rest your upper arm against the inside of your thigh or keep it fixed at your side.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulder.
Lower it with control and repeat, then switch arms.
tips: Only your forearm should move.
Pause and squeeze at the top.
results.description: Landmine Concentration Curl is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a barbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Brachialis.

results.name: Low Resistance Band Lying Bicep Curl Half Repetition
instructions: Attach the middle of the resistance band to a low anchor point in front of you. Lie on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a handle in each hand with your palms facing up and your arms extended straight by your sides.
Curl the handles halfway towards your shoulders by bending your elbows until your forearms are parallel to the floor, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back flat on the bench and avoid arching your spine.
Focus on engaging your biceps throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl the handles up and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Low Resistance Band Lying Bicep Curl Half Repetition is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Shoulders.

results.name: Low Resistance Band Lying Bicep Curl
instructions: Attach the middle of the resistance band to a low anchor point in front of you. Lie on a bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a handle in each hand with your palms facing up and your arms extended straight by your sides.
Curl the handles towards your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Slowly return to the starting position with control, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your back flat on the bench and avoid arching your spine.
Focus on engaging your biceps throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl the handles up and inhale as you lower them back down.
results.description: Low Resistance Band Lying Bicep Curl is a beginner single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a band, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms, Shoulders.

results.name: Plate Curl to Overhead Press
instructions: Stand tall holding a weight plate by its sides, arms extended in front of your thighs.
Curl the plate up to your chest by bending your elbows.
Press the plate straight overhead until your arms are extended.
Lower it back to your chest, then down to your thighs, and repeat.
tips: Keep your core braced so your lower back doesn't arch during the press.
Move through each phase with control.
results.description: Plate Curl to Overhead Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a weighted, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Forearms, Core.

results.name: Preacher Curl Dumbbells Simultaneous
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your feet flat on the floor, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip (palms facing up), and your arms extended over the preacher bench pad.
Engage your core and curl both dumbbells towards your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms pressed against the pad.
Squeeze your biceps at the top of the movement, ensuring the dumbbells reach shoulder height.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, fully extending your arms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Keep your upper arms stationary against the pad to isolate the biceps.
Keep your wrists straight and avoid letting them bend backward.
Exhale as you curl the dumbbells up and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Preacher Curl Dumbbells Simultaneous is an intermediate single-joint isolation pulling exercise targeting the biceps (upper arms). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Forearms.
